capabilities: Sync contacts from iCloud into per-contact notes with properties
Filter which contacts sync by selected iCloud groups
Download contact photos into the vault and link them
Insert custom markdown into every contact file
Sync a Nextcloud address book via a share URL
extras: Not affiliated with Apple; Nextcloud sync may fail when encryption is enabled, and only one Nextcloud address book can be tracked.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull contacts from an address book service, so linking notes to people requires manual entry.

relations.evidence: The IcloudClient in this codebase is copied and adapted from tsdav.
If using Nextcloud instead iCloud, copy-paste the address book's share URL
you can for example use the dataview plugin to display a table with email and phone number

summary: Syncs iCloud contacts into one Markdown note per contact, with contact details stored as properties.
